stepwise_argument.claim: The target theorem is existential and domain-specific: it claims that many natural graph-theoretic and combinatorial optimization problems are NP-complete under polynomial-time many-one reductions.

stepwise_argument.claim: Because no concrete problem family is constructed, the route cannot derive the target theorem even informally.
